summary: The base deterministically routes DSV4 paged prefill through top-k v1 because prefill allocates c4_sparse_raw_indices while the v2 branch requires raw_indices to be None. The exact candidate removes that contradictory guard and uses v2 to produce raw indices followed by a separate page-table transform when both outputs are required. Candidate regressions, existing real v2 kernel tests, and an independent 32K gfx950 numerical/adversarial check passed. This verifies the narrow dispatch correction but cannot establish absence of the original four-GB300 DeepSeek-V4-Pro serving crash.

tests.command: rg -n -C 4 'c4_sparse_raw_indices = torch.empty_like|should_use_topk_v2\(\) and raw_indices is None' python/sglang/srt/layers/attention/deepseek_v4_backend.py python/sglang/srt/layers/attention/dsv4/indexer.py (base)
tests.what_was_measured: Issue-specific source reproduction: prefill allocates the raw-index buffer and the paged dispatcher consequently excludes v2.
Failing-before preservation: the candidate regression file/helper does not exist on the recorded base. The stronger behavioral failure is the contradictory base dispatch condition recorded above.
Three candidate cases passed: raw and physical outputs use v2 without v1, no-raw retains the fused v2 path, and page_size=1 plus -1 padding translate correctly.
Two existing tests executed the actual v2 JIT kernel on the assigned AMD GPU in physical-page and raw-index modes.

Actual v2 raw selections at sequence length 32768 matched torch.topk multisets. Independent wrapper cases matched a torch.gather reference with page_size=3, repeated physical pages, invalid padding, and noncontiguous output views.
Known nearby ROCm-specific expectation mismatch: sgl-kernel expected dsa_drop_wide_page_table=true but observed false; the flashinfer subcase passed. This test does not exercise the changed helper.

gpu_execution.evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950-class capability [9,5], PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 / HIP 7.2.26015. Real v2 JIT execution and the 32K numerical comparison passed.

remaining_counterexamples: The original four-NVIDIA-GB300, CUDA 13, DeepSeek-V4-Pro FP4 TP/DP/EP serving workload was unavailable, so the reported illegal address was not reproduced on base and its absence was not observed on the candidate.
No model weights were available; the review does not validate DeepSeek-V4-Pro semantics, FP4 indexer execution, DP attention, hierarchical cache, speculative decoding, or multi-GPU behavior.
The candidate's extra PyTorch page-table transform is numerically verified on gfx950 but its performance and CUDA behavior on GB300 remain unmeasured.
A nearby ROCm test retains a pre-existing dsa_drop_wide_page_table expectation failure unrelated to the changed helper.
remaining_limitations: Architecture mismatch: AMD gfx950-class MI350X instead of NVIDIA GB300 compute capability 10.3.
Single GPU instead of the reported four-GPU TP4/DP4/EP4 workload.
No DeepSeek-V4-Pro weights or full serving reproduction.
No native source changed. The prepared repository declared no native rebuild target; source imports resolved to /job/repo while sgl_kernel resolved to the prepared installed package.
